description: The Threads account-growth strategy skill -- the channel layer above threads-post. Threads is conversation-first (neither X nor Instagram; positive culture), and the #1 growth lever is Mosseri's 'reply more than you post': replies are weighted heaviest and first-hour engagement velocity is the top ranking factor. Uses the TALKS framework. Reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first. The agent strategizes the channel + drafts original posts (WoopSocial publishes ONE text+media post <=500 chars, one topic tag, on a schedule) + can draft suggested replies; BUT the reply flywheel (the #1 lever) is human/community-management (no reply surface in the spec), and Communities/DMs/Account-Status dashboard/Threads analytics/Dear-Algo are native. No engagement-bait (downranked), original not recycled (prioritized), positive tone (negativity throttled), metrics never fabricated, growth compounds over 60-90 days. Distinct from threads-post (the single-post craft) and community-management (the reply execution), and uses Threads as a discovery funnel into instagram-growth.

evals.name: conversation_first_reply_more
evals.input: How do I grow on Threads?
expect: Frames Threads as conversation-first (not X, not Instagram; positive/constructive culture)
Centers Mosseri's #1 lever: reply MORE than you post -- your own replies count, and leaping into relevant conversations fast is the engine
Introduces the TALKS framework and reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first
Notes the reply flywheel itself is executed by a human/community-management (WoopSocial publishes the original posts)

evals.name: reads_brand_goals_first
expect: Pulls brand-profile (niche/voice) + goals-and-kpis before planning
Picks one sharp niche/angle for algorithm classification + audience trust
Sets a sustainable cadence (3-5 posts/week) tied to the goal
Defines the metrics to watch (replies-per-post / replies-to-reach, follower growth)

evals.name: velocity_niche_cadence
evals.input: Why isn't my Threads reach growing?
expect: Explains engagement velocity is the #1 ranking factor -- the first hour is critical (50 likes in 30 min beats 100 over 24h); post when the audience is awake and stay to reply
Recommends niche consistency (1-2 areas) so the algorithm classifies you and the audience trusts you
Advises consistency (3-5/week) over volume (>3/day fatigues and splits engagement)
Notes growth compounds over 60-90 days -- don't quit at two weeks

evals.name: format_mix_and_tags
evals.input: What should I post, and how many tags?
expect: Notes photos get ~60% more engagement than text-only, video with captions performs, and links now do ~17% better (still under media)
Uses ONE topic tag per post (not hashtags; no multi-tag strategy)
Emphasizes original content (recycled is demoted) and a positive, constructive tone
Routes the single-post craft to threads-post

evals.name: pushback_on_engagement_bait_and_recycling
evals.input: Post 'follow + like for a follow back' bait 10 times a day, spin and recycle my best X dunks, and promise me my 50k Instagram followers will all follow me on Threads.
expect: Refuses engagement-bait -- Mosseri confirmed Meta actively downranks it; and >3 posts/day fatigues the audience (3-5/week)
Refuses recycled/spun content (originality is prioritized; recycled is demoted) and notes dunks/negativity get throttled in Threads' positive culture
Corrects the Instagram assumption: an IG following doesn't automatically convert -- the algorithms differ, you have to earn it on Threads
Refuses to fabricate outcomes and offers a conversation-first, original, reply-driven plan

evals.name: edge_case_starting_cold_no_instagram
evals.input: I'm starting from zero with no Instagram audience -- can I still grow on Threads?
expect: Confirms yes: For You is an interest graph, so small/new accounts can reach large audiences via velocity + topic relevance
Recommends picking ONE niche and replying into relevant conversations to borrow other audiences (reply more than you post)
Sets expectations: momentum typically compounds over 60-90 days of consistent posting
Notes Instagram helps as a funnel but isn't required to start

evals.name: honest_scope_posts_publishable_replies_human
evals.input: Run my Threads -- post and reply to everyone for me.
expect: Clarifies the agent strategizes the channel + drafts the original posts (WoopSocial publishes ONE text+media post <=500 chars + one topic tag, on a schedule) and can draft suggested replies
States the reply flywheel -- the #1 growth lever -- is human/community-management because there's no reply surface in WoopSocial
States Communities, DMs, the Account Status dashboard, Threads analytics, and Dear Algo are native
Notes metrics come from native analytics and are never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just threads-post or community-management or x-growth?
expect: Distinguishes threads-growth (the account STRATEGY: conversation-first, reply-more-than-post cadence, niche, funnel, metrics) from threads-post (the single-post CRAFT / one 500-char post)
Distinguishes it from community-management (the reply execution + audience->community, where the reply flywheel is run)
Distinguishes it from x-growth (X's news/dunk culture) and notes instagram-growth is the funnel's conversion side
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
